interact_justification: README and https://certshell.dev explain how to get it; issues and contributions: https://github.com/maca134/certshell/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
documentation_interface_justification: Configuration (environment variables) and host enrollment are documented in the README: https://github.com/maca134/certshell#configuration
sites_https_justification: Project site, repo and image registry are HTTPS only: certshell.dev, github.com, ghcr.io.
english_justification: Docs and issue tracker are in English.
repo_interim_justification: All commits between releases are public on main.
version_unique_justification: Each release is a vX.Y.Z git tag and a matching ghcr.io image tag.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerabilities have been fixed in a release yet.
report_responses_justification: No bug reports yet; the maintainer responds to reports.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests yet; the maintainer responds to requests.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports yet; the maintainer commits to an initial response within 14 days.
build_justification: bun install && bun run build; the Dockerfile builds the release image.
build_floss_tools_justification: Bun, TypeScript, Vite and Docker are all FLOSS.
test_justification: Unit tests with bun test, browser tests with Playwright; see README Development.
test_invocation_justification: bun run test (and bun run e2e).
test_most_justification: Tests cover the API routes, auth, the SSH CA, certificate minting, tasks and terminals, plus Playwright e2e flows.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/maca134/certshell/actions/workflows/ci.yml runs on every push and PR and must pass to merge.
tests_are_added_justification: Feature commits include tests in apps/*/test and apps/web/e2e.
warnings_justification: Biome lint and TypeScript strict mode.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any lint or type error.
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript strict: true in every package; Biome recommended rules.
know_common_errors_justification: Input validation, strict security headers, rate limits, hardened container; see SPEC.md and README Security.
crypto_published_justification: OpenSSH certificates (Ed25519), OIDC via openid-client; no custom algorithms.
crypto_call_justification: Uses ssh-keygen, openid-client/jose and WebCrypto; no crypto is reimplemented.
crypto_floss_justification: OpenSSH, openid-client and jose are FLOSS.
crypto_keylength_justification: Ed25519 for the CA and all certificate keys.
crypto_working_justification: No broken algorithms (MD5, SHA-1, DES, RC4).
crypto_pfs_justification: SSH key exchange is ephemeral; TLS is terminated by the deployer's reverse proxy.
crypto_password_storage_justification: No user passwords are stored; users log in through an external OIDC provider.
delivery_mitm_justification: Source and images are delivered over HTTPS (GitHub, ghcr.io); base images are pinned by digest.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are fetched over plain HTTP.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No unpatched medium or higher vulnerabilities older than 60 days; release images must pass a Trivy scan.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Trivy blocks releases with fixable HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs; Dependabot security updates are on.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials in the repo; GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (security-extended) on every push and PR, plus Biome and the TypeScript compiler in CI.
dynamic_analysis_justification: No fuzzer or web scanner yet.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Written in TypeScript, a memory-safe language.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis is run yet.
